newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Ancor upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ancor upgraded to buy.

text.p: John G. Kinnard & Co said Monday it upgraded its rating on Ancor Communications Inc to a buy from a hold and set a 12-month price target of $14.

-- Analyst Frank McEvoy said he expects new products and contracts from original equipment manufacturers to generate strong revenue growth through 1998 for Ancor, which makes and markets switches, adapters and integrated circuits.
-- Shares of Ancor were trading up 1/2 to 8-3/8.
